hero.eyebrow: For your olive grove. For every year of it.
hero.title: Your olive grove’s story lives here.
hero.sub: Record what you do today and find it clearly whenever you need it: work, harvest, expenses, notes, photos, and whatever explains a year.
hero.trust: Your first field is free · For your own or a family grove

memory.title: What you know about your grove deserves to stay.
memory.text: A note on the phone, a conversation in the field, an old notebook — all of it is useful until you need to find it. Oleachron keeps it with the field and its year.
memory.close: What happened. When it happened. Why it matters.
memory.photoAlt: An old notebook and notes, with the grove in afternoon light

chronologio.title: History is your grove’s memory.
chronologio.text: It doesn’t just keep records. It shows the thread: what happened, in which field, under what conditions, and what followed.
points: Remember what you did last year

journal.noteTitle: Fruit darkened on the south side
journal.sepDetail: A quiet day in the field, before October opened.
journal.novDetail: October’s oil stayed tied to the same field.
journal.detailWeather: 12 mm of rain, the day the pruning was finished.
journal.detailTask: The task closed on 8 October. It stays with the field.
journal.detailNote: A note with a photo, before harvest began.
journal.detailHarvest: 42 sacks, 860 kg of olives, 148 litres of oil.
journal.detailExpense: €320 of labour, tied to this field.
journal.shotAlt: October History for Kato Alonia: a task, a note, weather, a harvest and an expense

capabilities.title: From the field to the year’s reckoning.
capabilities.bridge: Not six tools. Everything becomes part of the grove’s story.

items.title: Your groves on the map
items.outcome: See each field as it is.
items.text: Find its place, keep its boundaries, and always have the picture of the grove in front of you.

items.title: Work that isn’t forgotten
items.text: Create tasks for each field, set a time and a repeat, and mark them as soon as they’re done.

items.title: A record in a few seconds
items.outcome: Keep the moment before it fades.
items.text: Write a note, add a photo, or log an expense the moment it happens.

items.title: Your harvest, without scraps of paper
items.outcome: Sacks, kilos, oil and expenses, on the same field.
items.text: Add what comes off as you pick, and close the harvest with a clear result.

items.title: Expenses and a picture of the year
items.outcome: See what it cost and what it returned.
items.text: Tie expenses and income to the right field, so your reckoning makes sense.

items.title: Weather, vegetation and past seasons
items.outcome: See your grove through the data as well.
items.text: Conditions and the field’s picture, always beside what actually happened.

map.title: See your grove differently, without losing the real picture.
map.text: Find your fields, keep their boundaries, and see how conditions change through the year. The map, the weather and the vegetation sit beside what actually happened in the grove.
map.marchFact: In March the field’s picture was more uneven.
map.juneFact: In June the field’s picture was more even.

harvest.title: The harvest goes in simply.
harvest.text: In the field you write the sacks. At the mill, the kilos. Then the oil. Each day joins that field’s year on its own.

steps.label: Sacks
steps.ask: How many did you pick today?

steps.title: Start simply. Your grove builds its own story.
steps.step1Text: Find it on the map and keep its basic details.
steps.step2Text: A task, a note, an expense, or today’s harvest.
steps.step3Title: Watch the year take on meaning
steps.step3Text: History organises what happened, so you can find it again and use it.

trust.title: Made for people who carry the grove in mind.
trust.text: For you, caring for your own or a family grove and wanting to keep what you learn each year. Simple in the field, clear when you come home.
labels: A record in a few seconds

cta.title: Don’t let another year stay on scraps of paper.
cta.text: Start your grove on Oleachron and keep what matters, from today.
cta.primary: Start with your first field free
